press_references.value: Komodor Redefines Kubernetes Cost Optimization with Holistic Automation Based on Performance, Risk and Right-Sizing

product_launches.description: Komodor has launched advanced new cost optimization capabilities for its Kubernetes management platform, enabling organizations to reduce cloud spend while maintaining performance and reliability. The new features include real-time spend visibility, AI-driven workload right-sizing, advanced bin-packing, and autopilot optimization modes.

press_references.value: Komodor Introduces Single Pane of Glass Management Solution that Spans Kubernetes and its Diverse Add-On Ecosystem

product_launches.description: Komodor's new platform version extends Kubernetes management to support the full ecosystem of K8 add-ons, providing centralized visibility, automated troubleshooting, and reduced operational complexity.

overview_description.description: Komodor is a Dev-First Kubernetes operations platform focused on automating Kubernetes operations. The platform ingests Kubernetes events each day and then bakes the key learnings directly into the system. Komodor enables developers to gain a clear understanding of all events and dependencies inside a cluster. Every deployment, configuration, and code change can be tracked and correlated with the status of nodes, pods, endpoints, and other K8s infrastructure elements.

about_short_description.short_description: Komodor tracks changes and alerts across the Kubernetes stack and analyzes their effect.

product.name: Komodor AI SRE Platform
product.description: A cloud-native operations platform that provides Kubernetes and infrastructure visibility, incident investigation, root-cause analysis, remediation, reliability management, and cost optimization.

product.name: Klaudia Agentic AI
product.description: An AI-powered SRE capability that detects, investigates, explains, and remediates issues across Kubernetes and cloud-native environments.

product.name: Kubernetes Troubleshooting
product.description: A Kubernetes troubleshooting capability that centralizes operational context and correlates changes, events, logs, and dependencies to accelerate root-cause analysis and incident resolution.

product.name: Kubernetes Health & Reliability Management
product.description: A reliability management capability for monitoring Kubernetes health, identifying systemic causes of failures, improving SLO and SLA adherence, and enforcing operational policies.

product.name: Kubernetes Cost & Performance Optimization
product.description: A capability for identifying Kubernetes infrastructure and workload inefficiencies, reducing cloud waste, and balancing resource cost with application performance and reliability.

product.name: Cloud-Native Infrastructure Visualization & Insights
product.description: A centralized visualization capability for exploring Kubernetes clusters, workloads, dependencies, changes, events, and operational signals across the cloud-native stack.
